mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 68 degrees with mainly clear skies at Verona Community Park, and we are seeing the third quarter moon phase.
The city is currently working with AECOM for engineering projects, and the Senior Center is offering free 30-minute tri-shaw bike rides for residents who sign up online.
We have live music today at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus the Dane County Farmers' Market happens tomorrow at the Capitol Square.
In police news, on July 31, an officer conducted a traffic stop that led to a citation for drug possession after smelling marijuana in the vehicle.
Today's flavor is the fan-favorite Really Reese's. The shop is currently closed but will open at 10 AM. If you miss out today, tomorrow's flavor will be Andes Mint Avalanche.
